analysis.title: DeskTalk - US tech and USD gains, look to levels
key_insights: NVDA's earnings were solid and gave relief to the AI trade. The USD also got a renewed bid as the European session began.
Gold is the notable underperformer, with spot down 2.4%.
Levels are flagged for ES1, EUR, GBP and ZAR, with choppy price action still expected. The day's events are Trump in China and the FOMC minutes.

NVDA raised its outlook and forecast strong sales and revenue for FY27. Citi notes that Nvidia's more selective approach to financing AI infrastructure projects could moderate growth for some neocloud operators if funding becomes constrained.
Nasdaq futures (NQA) are up 1%, with smaller gains in ES1, after risk-off price action on Tuesday. The ES1 200-day moving average is at 7,374.
Citi's model signals CTAs could halt their selling in SPX and move back to moderately short if the index rallies back above 7,474 (+0.5% vs 7439 ESZ6).
The USD is rising again against European currencies and EM FX. EURUSD is at 1.0960, in the middle of support.
GBPUSD is approaching the year's triple bottom at 1.3140/60, which Citi's trader is watching as support. UK CPI came in line, with services slightly softer.

ZAR weakened this morning. Citi's trader attributes it to falling gold prices and a stronger DXY, which pushed USDZAR through 17.00. Price action looks stoppish, and 17.20-25 is the next level to watch.

market_movers.rationale: Solid earnings and a raised outlook with strong FY27 sales and revenue forecasts relieved the AI trade. More selective financing of AI infrastructure projects could moderate growth for some neocloud operators.

earnings_insights: NVDA reported solid earnings and raised its outlook, forecasting strong sales and revenue for FY27. The note gives no EPS or revenue figures, and no consensus comparison.
